description:
Import a managed lead list into local lead records so the rest of these tools can work with it. 

Run it after create_lead_list, or on any existing list from list_lead_lists, to pull its contacts in. Until a list is synced its contacts are invisible to list_leads, enrich_lead and send_to_campaign. 

Writes local lead records, and OVERWRITES any saved lead with the same email address: its name, role, company, score and verification status are replaced and it is detached from its search job. Re-syncing the same list refreshes rather than duplicating. Requires an API key. Costs no credits; enrichment and verification are billed separately.

listId.description: Lead list ID from list_lead_lists (integer as string)

name: sync_lead_list
